deadline.value: Priority deadline for funded assistantships is February 1 for Fall, for domestic and international applicants; the regular international deadline is May 1.
deadline.quote: Priority deadline for domestic and international students wanting to be considered for funded assistantships: Fall Semester: February 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department page does not say whether a faculty adviser must agree before admission.

funding.value: Most incoming PhD students are funded by teaching assistantships for at least their first year, then usually by research assistantships.
funding.quote: Most of our incoming Ph.D. students are funded with teaching assistantships for at least their first year.

entry_route.value: The admission list asks for undergraduate transcripts and a 3.0 undergraduate GPA; no master's is listed.
entry_route.quote: Minimum 3.0 GPA in undergraduate program (based on A=4.0).

gre_general.value: The department says GRE scores are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are NOT required, but can be submitted.

notes: The same department offers a Ph.D. in Engineering, Industrial Engineering Option (IMSE). Its page shows the same admissions list, but no separate IMSE rules were checked. Applied Mechanics is an option of the civil PhD.
